traditional: A 同 B 冇關係
jyutping: A tung4 B mou5 gwaan1 hai6

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken way to say that one matter has no bearing on another; Cantonese usually expresses the idea as a clause rather than an abstract noun.

examples.english: This matter has nothing to do with the report, so don't bring up this irrelevancy again.
examples.traditional: 呢件事同份報告冇關係，唔好再講喇。
examples.jyutping: ne1 gin6 si6 tung4 fan6 bou3 gou3 mou5 gwaan1 hai6 m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2 laa3
